attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Renames the public IndexeIds property (used in serialized IndexProfileDeploymentStep JSON) to IndexIds and changes the recipe step registration from IndexingProfileStep to CreateOrUpdateIndexProfileStep with a new StepKey, which will silently break existing deployment plans/recipes referencing the old property or step name since no backward-compatible alias is provided."}

reason: Renames the public IndexeIds property (used in serialized IndexProfileDeploymentStep JSON) to IndexIds and changes the recipe step registration from IndexingProfileStep to CreateOrUpdateIndexProfileStep with a new StepKey, which will silently break existing deployment plans/recipes referencing the old property or step name since no backward-compatible alias is provided.
